simple.meaning: דִּבְרָה (dibrâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “intent, sake.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Daniel 2:30. The surrounding context includes kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דִּבְרָה (H1701) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: דִּבְרָה (dibrâh) / H1701 is traced through Daniel 2:30, Daniel 4:14 with generated occurrence evidence.
